description:
Lists the tools saved in your private toolbox with their live state, alerts when one got worse since you saved it, and what is new on Faceabot since your last visit (your last visit date is updated). Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…"}

key.description: Your toolbox key (fbk_…). Omit on your first save.

name: list_my_toolbox
title: List my toolbox
